Container.Name: print-handy
Container.Overview:
Print Handy runs everything in ONE container: the Discord bot, the Moonraker listener, OrcaSlicer (stable 2.4.2 or alpha 2.5.0-alpha, chosen with PRINT_HANDY_ORCA_CHANNEL) and the bundled Spoolman API under one supervisor. Print Handy is the interface; Spoolman's web UI is not included. The Spoolman API listens on 127.0.0.1:8000 inside the container and no port is published. Printers are external services.
UPGRADE FROM 2.1.1: the three old containers are replaced by this one. Stop the old bot, listener and Spoolman containers first, and point the Spoolman Data path at your existing Spoolman data so inventory carries over (the database migrates forward on startup; there is no automatic downgrade, and nothing is migrated for you). Leave the Discord token empty to stage and validate first: the listener and Spoolman run while the bot stays idle. Never run the old and new Discord bots at the same time.
The variables below are the ones the current stable image actually reads: they mirror the Docker Compose / DockerMan contract in the print-handy repository (docker-compose.yml, .env.example and docker/unraid/print-handy.xml).
WHAT STABLE MEANS: this template installs the stable channel. The :latest tag moves only when a new stable Print Handy release is published, and it selects the current stable multi-arch build (amd64 and arm64). There is no fixed digest to verify because the tag floats by design; the verified digest and source revision for each release are recorded in its GitHub release notes.
UPGRADE NOTE — this project was renamed from Print Buddy to Print Handy, and this template is a NEW Community Applications app (the old one was print-buddy): existing Print Buddy installs do not auto-migrate. Install this template, copy your old appdata (/mnt/user/appdata/print-buddy) into the new print-handy appdata paths (renaming any print_buddy_* state files to print_handy_*), move the configuration values across under the new PRINT_HANDY__... variable names, start this container and check it is healthy, then remove the old app. Full steps are in docs/RENAME-MIGRATION.md in the project repo.
Container.ExtraParams: --user 1000:1000 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --pids-limit 256 --memory 2g --cpus 2 --shm-size 256m --log-driver json-file --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 --restart unless-stopped --health-cmd "python3 /usr/local/bin/print-handy-healthcheck" --health-interval 30s --health-timeout 10s --health-start-period 90s --health-retries 3
Container.Requires: Appdata paths owned by UID/GID 1000. Existing Spoolman data can be copied into the Spoolman Data path before first start; nothing is migrated automatically.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Runtime state, prompts, hardware and job records. Back this up.

Config.Name: Archive
Config.Description: Sliced jobs and G-code. Back this up.

Config.Name: Spoolman data
Config.Description: Bundled Spoolman database, config, logs and backups. Back this up.

Config.Name: Settings file
Config.Description: Leave as is, or point at a mounted YAML file for list settings.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Secret. Leave empty to stage the listener and Spoolman without the Discord bot.

Config.Name: Allowed user IDs
Config.Description: Optional whitelist of Discord user IDs allowed to use the bot, comma or space separated. Leave empty (the default) and everyone who can post in the print channel can use the bot — the channel is the access boundary.

Config.Name: Denied user IDs
Config.Description: Optional deny list of Discord user IDs, comma or space separated. A denied user is refused even when whitelisted or the approval user; a refusal is logged and answered once per user per hour.

Config.Name: Moonraker URL
Config.Description: Klipper printers, for example http://printer.example:7125. Fluidd is not needed here.

Config.Name: Spoolman URL
Config.Description: Bundled Spoolman API by default. To use an existing external Spoolman, set its URL here and set Bundled Spoolman to false; nothing is migrated.

Config.Name: Bundled Spoolman
Config.Description: true runs the bundled Spoolman API; false uses the external Spoolman URL.

Config.Name: OrcaSlicer channel
Config.Description: Bundled OrcaSlicer channel selected at startup: stable (default) or alpha. Any other value stops the container at startup.

Config.Name: Container timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, an IANA name such as UTC. Print Handy schedules use the discord.timezone setting; TZ covers container logs, the OS clock and the bundled Spoolman.
